{'translation': 'The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked several upcoming Apple home products, including an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a Siri Remote designed for the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad device.'}

{'translation': "After an in-depth code analysis, several important clues regarding the HomePad's specifications have also surfaced…"}

{'translation': 'Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that the HomePad is very likely to run a variant of tvOS, but the way you operate it might be closer to a giant Apple Watch.'}

{'translation': 'The code also revealed a rather interesting privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.'}

{'translation': 'We expect the HomePad to come in two versions: one equipped with a basic speaker and looking similar to a HomePod, and another designed to be wall-mounted.'}

{'translation': 'Besides the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, the code also references some devices that have yet to be revealed. I really hope a smart doorbell is among them. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.'}
